title: Three Teens Are Convinced That Laws Don’t Apply To Them
description:
On December 10th, 2022, officers responded to a report of disorderly conduct. They were informed by mall security that three young girls, who appeared to be minors, were refusing to show identification as per the mall’s policy and were attempting to flee. The officer was able to locate them based on the description provided. One of the females started resisting the officers, escalating the situation. She continued to scream and argue with the officers while being taken outside. All the girls were taken to the police units and transported to jail.  Dasani was charged with resisting arrest and disorderly conduct. Parizhe was charged with unlawful use of a weapon, resisting arrest and disorderly conduct. And Dazia was charged with disorderly conduct.
